title: Nicola Peltz Plans Sweet Birthday Surprise For Brooklyn Beckham Amid Family Feud | Hollywood News - News18
text: On Brooklyn Beckham’s 27th birthday on Wednesday, March 4, his wife Nicola Peltz planned a sweet surprise for him. Taking to her Instagram account, she gave their fans a glimpse into the birthday surprise she had planned for her husband. The clip showed a room decorated with golden balloons, flowers, gifts, and a box of pink doughnuts arranged to spell out the message, “Happy Birthday, Brooklyn". The Cloud23 founder appeared pleasantly surprised as he looked over the decorations and the sweet treat. “Wow, that’s cool," he said while admiring the gesture of his wife. Brooklyn even picked up one of the doughnuts to eat, after which Nicola gently asked him to make a birthday wish and blow out the candles placed on the doughnut. Brooklyn Beckham Was Touched By His Wife’s Gesture She then wished her husband, saying, “Happy birthday, I love you." Brooklyn, in turn, responded to her, “I love you," and blew a kiss to her. Nicola then added, “I hope your wishes come true." Following this, Brooklyn leaned in and paused for several seconds as he thought about his wish before finally blowing out the candles on the doughnuts. Clearly touched by the gesture, he then said, “Aw, this is so sweet." Alongside the short clip, Nicola shared a sweet message celebrating her husband’s 27th birthday. She wrote, “Happy birthday, baby. I hope all your dreams and wishes come true! you light up every room you walk into and anyone who knows you loves you, you’re the most special human and I love being your wife. I love you, I love you, I love you." Brooklyn responded to the wish in the comments section, affectionately writing, “My baby girl xxx." David And Victoria Beckham Also Wished Brooklyn On His Birthday Meanwhile, Brooklyn’s parents, David and Victoria Beckham, also marked their eldest son’s birthday with heartfelt Instagram messages, even as reports of a family rift continue to circulate. Both parents shared a throwback photo of a young Brooklyn between them in a pool. Victoria, taking to her Instagram Story, wrote, “Happy birthday Brooklyn, we love you so much." David Beckham added his own note with a happy tears emoji: “27 Today. Happy Birthday, Bust. We love you x." The birthday wishes come amid an ongoing estrangement reportedly triggered by Brooklyn’s 2022 marriage to model and actress Nicola Peltz Beckham. While Victoria and David were public in sending birthday love, Brooklyn has not yet responded to their posts, keeping the status of their relationship uncertain.
